Continuing from the next unscreened rank keeps this selection just as unpickable by me as the original five - not chosen because it seemed likely to produce any particular outcome.

note: R3 is NOT evaluated in this file for the qualifying candidate - see docs/evidence/ci-reproduction-05-rimraf-reference-plan.json and the bridge rehearsal evidence for that. The inference engine was not consulted for any row below.
additionalR4Exclusions: axios/date-fns/fastify/immer are excluded here too, even though they were never used by a CI_REPRODUCTION attempt specifically - they already appear elsewhere in DiffCI's validation history (the external-validation/economics thread), and reusing them here would blur the same independence this frame exists to protect.

rows.detail: R1/R2 both pass mechanically (large real matrix, ubuntu-latest+node-22 cells present and green in recent completed runs), but the job's actual Node-version matrix is computed at runtime by a third-party reusable action (ljharb/actions/node/matrix@main) and its install step is another reusable action (ljharb/actions/node/install@main) - neither's real behavior is stated in this repository's own workflow YAML. Hand-transcribing 'the exact command this cell runs' would require reverse-engineering an external actions repository, which is exactly the kind of human command repair the reference-plan discipline forbids. Not evaluated against R3 - rejected before that step, on legibility of the workflow itself, not on any expectation about outcome.

single job, statically-declared matrix (no reusable/dynamic matrix generation), two plainly-stated commands (npm install; npm test -- -c -t0), no reusable install action, no step-level env or if: conditions referencing matrix context - directly transcribable from .github/workflows/ci.yml with zero repair.

groundTruth.source: github actions run 25937631695, job within it

rows.caveat: This workflow's most recent completed run before the pinned commit is over 4 months old relative to when this screening was performed (2026-09-03) - the repository's CI runs on push-to-main and a path-filtered pull_request trigger, and simply hasn't had a qualifying event since. Recorded because the bridge rehearsal (unlike this screening) runs against the repository's live current HEAD, not this pinned ground-truth commit - the same kind of plan-age caveat noted for eslint's rehearsal, here potentially larger.
